name: General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679
description: All 99 articles of the Regulation with their titles and chapters. Articles 5 to 50, the obligations on controllers and processors and the rights of data subjects, also carry a one-line summary; the other articles carry a title only. The text of the articles is not loaded.

controls.title: Principles relating to processing of personal data
controls.description: Personal data is processed lawfully, fairly and transparently, for specified purposes, minimised, kept accurate, kept no longer than needed, secured, and the controller can demonstrate it.

controls.title: Lawfulness of processing
controls.description: Processing is lawful only if at least one of the listed legal bases applies.

controls.title: Conditions for consent
controls.description: Where consent is the basis the controller can demonstrate it, and the data subject can withdraw it as easily as it was given.

controls.title: Child's consent in relation to information society services
controls.description: Consent for information society services offered directly to a child is valid only with parental authorisation below the age threshold.

controls.title: Processing of special categories of personal data
controls.description: Processing special categories of personal data is prohibited unless a listed exception applies.

controls.title: Criminal convictions and offences data
controls.description: Processing of criminal conviction and offence data is carried out only under official authority or as authorised by law.

controls.title: Processing which does not require identification
controls.description: A controller need not collect extra data solely to identify a data subject.

controls.title: Transparent information and modalities for exercising rights
controls.description: Information and communications to data subjects are concise, transparent and easily accessible, and requests are answered within one month.
controls.category: Chapter III: Rights of the data subject

controls.title: Information to be provided where data is collected from the data subject
controls.description: Specified information is given to the data subject when data is collected from them.
controls.category: Chapter III: Rights of the data subject

controls.title: Information to be provided where data is not obtained from the data subject
controls.description: Specified information is given to the data subject when data is obtained from another source.
controls.category: Chapter III: Rights of the data subject

controls.title: Right of access by the data subject
controls.description: The data subject can obtain confirmation, a copy and details of the processing of their data.
controls.category: Chapter III: Rights of the data subject

controls.title: Right to rectification
controls.description: The data subject can have inaccurate data rectified and incomplete data completed.
controls.category: Chapter III: Rights of the data subject

controls.title: Right to erasure
controls.description: The data subject can have personal data erased where a listed ground applies.
controls.category: Chapter III: Rights of the data subject

controls.title: Right to restriction of processing
controls.description: The data subject can restrict processing in listed circumstances.
controls.category: Chapter III: Rights of the data subject

controls.title: Notification obligation regarding rectification, erasure or restriction
controls.description: Recipients are notified of rectification, erasure or restriction.
controls.category: Chapter III: Rights of the data subject

controls.title: Right to data portability
controls.description: The data subject can receive their data in a structured, machine-readable format and transmit it to another controller.
controls.category: Chapter III: Rights of the data subject

controls.title: Right to object
controls.description: The data subject can object to processing based on public interest or legitimate interests, and to direct marketing.
controls.category: Chapter III: Rights of the data subject

controls.title: Automated individual decision-making, including profiling
controls.description: The data subject has the right not to be subject to solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects.
controls.category: Chapter III: Rights of the data subject

controls.title: Restrictions
controls.description: Union or Member State law may restrict the scope of these rights under listed conditions.
controls.category: Chapter III: Rights of the data subject

controls.title: Responsibility of the controller
controls.description: The controller implements and reviews appropriate technical and organisational measures and can demonstrate compliance.

controls.title: Data protection by design and by default
controls.description: Data protection by design and by default is built into processing.

controls.title: Joint controllers
controls.description: Joint controllers determine their respective responsibilities by arrangement.

controls.title: Representatives of controllers or processors not established in the Union
controls.description: Controllers and processors not established in the Union designate a representative in the Union.

controls.title: Processor
controls.description: Processors give sufficient guarantees and process only under a binding contract with the controller.

controls.title: Processing under the authority of the controller or processor
controls.description: A processor and persons acting under it process personal data only on the controller's instructions.

controls.title: Records of processing activities
controls.description: Controllers and processors maintain records of processing activities.

controls.title: Cooperation with the supervisory authority
controls.description: Controllers and processors cooperate with the supervisory authority on request.

controls.title: Security of processing
controls.description: Controllers and processors implement security measures appropriate to the risk.

controls.title: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority
controls.description: Personal data breaches are notified to the supervisory authority without undue delay and where feasible within 72 hours.

controls.title: Communication of a personal data breach to the data subject
controls.description: High-risk personal data breaches are communicated to the affected data subjects without undue delay.

controls.title: Data protection impact assessment
controls.description: A data protection impact assessment is carried out where processing is likely to result in high risk.

controls.title: Prior consultation
controls.description: The controller consults the supervisory authority before processing where an impact assessment indicates high residual risk.

controls.title: Designation of the data protection officer
controls.description: A data protection officer is designated in the cases the Regulation lists.

controls.title: Position of the data protection officer
controls.description: The data protection officer is involved properly, resourced, independent and reports to the highest management level.

controls.title: Tasks of the data protection officer
controls.description: The data protection officer informs and advises, monitors compliance and acts as contact point for the supervisory authority.

controls.title: Codes of conduct
controls.description: Codes of conduct are encouraged to contribute to the proper application of the Regulation.

controls.title: Monitoring of approved codes of conduct
controls.description: Compliance with approved codes of conduct is monitored by an accredited body.

controls.title: Certification
controls.description: Data protection certification mechanisms, seals and marks are encouraged.

controls.title: Certification bodies
controls.description: Certification bodies are accredited and issue and renew certification.

controls.title: General principle for transfers
controls.description: Transfers of personal data to third countries take place only where the conditions of this Chapter are met.
controls.category: Chapter V: Transfers of personal data to third countries or international organisations

controls.title: Transfers on the basis of an adequacy decision
controls.description: Transfers may take place to a country, territory or sector the Commission has found to ensure an adequate level of protection.
controls.category: Chapter V: Transfers of personal data to third countries or international organisations

controls.title: Transfers subject to appropriate safeguards
controls.description: Absent an adequacy decision, transfers require appropriate safeguards with enforceable rights and effective remedies.
controls.category: Chapter V: Transfers of personal data to third countries or international organisations

controls.title: Binding corporate rules
controls.description: Binding corporate rules approved by the supervisory authority can provide safeguards for transfers within a group.
controls.category: Chapter V: Transfers of personal data to third countries or international organisations

controls.title: Transfers or disclosures not authorised by Union law
controls.description: A third-country court or authority decision requiring transfer or disclosure is recognised only on the basis of an international agreement.
controls.category: Chapter V: Transfers of personal data to third countries or international organisations

controls.title: Derogations for specific situations
controls.description: Transfers without adequacy or safeguards are permitted only in the listed specific situations.
controls.category: Chapter V: Transfers of personal data to third countries or international organisations

controls.title: International cooperation for the protection of personal data
controls.description: The Commission and supervisory authorities develop international cooperation for the protection of personal data.
controls.category: Chapter V: Transfers of personal data to third countries or international organisations
